# vendor/ — third-party data

`zoom-explorer-g2four.json` comes from
[thammer/zoom-explorer](https://github.com/thammer/zoom-explorer),
`public/zoom-effect-mappings-g2four.json`, commit `aee0143` (2026-09-28).
MIT license: see `LICENSE-zoom-explorer`.

Shape: `{ "<effect id, 8 hex digits>": { name, screenName, parameters: [{ name, values[], max, default }] } }`.
The key is the 29-bit effect ID from the patch EDTB chunk.
